title: Safety and Effectiveness Study of a Non-Crosslinked HA Alkylamide HYADD(TM) 4 Hydrogel for Osteoarthritis of the Knee
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether intra-articular hyaluronic acid provides symptomatic relief of osteoarthritis of the knee.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Symptomatic osteoarthritis of the knee.

Exclusion Criteria:

* No disorders which could interfere with study required assessments.
